digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch-triggered workflow saturates the Free plan 20-job concurrency limit during independent patchset bursts, causing runner-job queues up to 873s and repository-local queue depths of 22 waiting jobs at peak.

Current workflow schedules 13 full-route jobs immediately after classification (13-way fan-out), with maximum per-run cost of 24 jobs including up to 7 mutation shards and exactly one macOS job occupying the scarce 5-macOS-job org limit.

Organization plan is Free with 20 total and 5 macOS concurrent jobs; measured incident-period bursts (7 runs in 5 minutes) and current-period bursts (3 runs in 5 minutes) both created queue depths and latencies inconsistent with available capacity.

Option A (bundle four preflights into one sequential job, cap mutation matrix at 3) reduces full-route peak simultaneous demand from 19 to 12 jobs, retains all coverage, and adds minimal latency on non-mutation-heavy runs.

Option C (move macOS to scheduled branch-health, exclude from pre-merge Verified) frees one macOS slot per full run and saves 9-11 minutes latency per run but introduces up to 6-hour macOS pre-merge coverage gap.

No CI behavior was changed; ticket remains open awaiting operator decision on one of four mutually exclusive first-move options before implementation plan is rewritten and submitted for held-out TDD workflow.
